notes.title: October Update!
notes.content:
What's New For October Update!🦇
Content Added:
- With New Visual Look.

New Mechanics:
- Introduced shooting mechanics with a gun.
- Puzzle elements to add depth to your gameplay.
- Third-person walking added. ( We dive into Alfred's past memories before the virus stuck )

Minor Improvements:
- Improved control responsiveness.
- Minor UI tweaks.
- Frame Optimization for Smoother gameplay experience.

Enjoy the update, and more to come!🎃
